# The law of the GameBoard

The one document of the law: what the engine computes, in whole numbers,
and why. Every symbol is named in English where it first appears. A
scalar is written plain, a vector in bold lowercase (**n**), a matrix or
an operator in bold uppercase (**C**). A line that no longer holds is
not in this document.

## The GameBoard and the families

### The objects

A **Node** is a physical location. The **GameBoard** is all the Nodes
together, a box of `shape` = (N_x, N_y, N_z) Nodes; each axis is periodic
(the box a torus on that axis) or open (a face beyond which no Node
lies), as the world declares, and a face may be declared receding
(**The unbounded board**, below). Two Nodes that differ by one step along
one axis are joined by a **Link**; each Node has six Links, one through
each of its six **Ports**, named by their outward direction +x, -x, +y,
-y, +z, -z. An axis of one layer folds: its two Ports return the Node
itself. An **inner face** is the face's rule declared inside the board
(the owner's word of 2026-09-30: the wall of the two slits is not matter
but the board's own face): a plane of Nodes across an axis, beyond the
board but for the gaps the world declares; a Node beyond the board is
read as 0 through every Port and reads 0 through its own (a held row
with a declared rest, the massless row at the file's c_vac, read at its
rest there, the vacuum beyond the face being the same vacuum;
**The vacuum content**, [what is open](#what-is-open), item 22), so no
level, current or source crosses its Links, nothing is laid or sourced
there, and no body, message or detector stands there; a declaration of
the file, like the wraps and the detectors' regions, and no number of the
engine. The local information of a Node is its **NodeState**: per
family, per part, two levels and Rule3's remainder, and per held part the
one remainder of its write, and nothing else; its count, its sense, its
currents and its tension are readings of the record
([the count is the record's share](#the-count-is-the-records-share);
[the primitives](#the-primitives), a family's write is one act).
A change of a NodeState is an **Event**; the rule that makes it is a
**LocalRule**, and there is one LocalRule, Rule3 ([Rule3](#rule3)).

A **family** is one kind of physical value with its own declarations
([a family's declaration](#a-familys-declaration)). A family's **record** is a set of levels over the
GameBoard, two levels per Node (now and before) with a remainder per Node;
the family's level at a Node is one number.
A **body** is a set of Nodes on which a family's **count** stands, with
the values the body's writer declares (its content, its momentum, its
spin, its moment); a body is one connected region. A **message** is a
record the world lays and no body: a packet of a family of quanta, its
axis, its wave number, its amplitude and its envelope declared in the
file and its levels the generator's ([the generator](#the-generator) (h)).

### A family's declaration

Every physical number comes from the world's files: the universe file
(the families and the universe's integers) and the world file (the
bodies, the detectors, the readings). The engine holds no number of its
own; a scale that is no physics (the amplitude unit A of [the generator](#the-generator) (f), a
product bound) is derived from the integer width, never written.

Node, every family's clock unit); the quantum's action T (`quantum_action`),
the action of one quantum of any family, a unit as Gamma is; the momentum unit Q_unit; and the vacuum content c_vac, the level at which the massless row rests at the faces, and everywhere where no write is declared, a key of that row in the universe file, 0 by the owner's word (**The vacuum content**, [what is open](#what-is-open), item 22; the owner's word of 2026-09-30, 23:15, #1563 comment 5921436204), the faces' content the positive bound U_faces >= Lambda R^2 / 6 where the vacuum's write is declared, the write's number one more declaration of the file (**The vacuum writes**, the owner's word of 2026-10-01, 19:22).

### Readings and measurements

A **measurement** is a detector's click: the detector's report of one

([the count is the record's share](#the-count-is-the-records-share)), for

Only a measurement is compared
with nature, clicks against clicks, and what produces a click is not

5912097355). A **GameBoard reading** (a level, a support, a total, a

Every run is headless; the readings are declared in the world file and
written in one format, each labelled DETECTOR, GAMEBOARD or HOST.

## Rule3

### The line

Rule3 is named for the three axes of the lattice, the three directions of the vector the rule works with: the Link's paces (p_x, p_y, p_z) are that vector, and the line has one read coefficient per direction, R_a = 2 num p_a^2, serving the direction's two Ports; the six Ports and the wall's 6 in w = 6 den Gamma^2 are the three directions twice, so the six follows from the three; in time the rule is a three-level recurrence (before, now, next), and in light's own line, num = den at the vacuum's paces, the three stands in the open: a_next = the six arrivals over 3 minus a_before.

**The law in one line**: at every Node, each interval, the division act below with its coefficients from the family's pair and the Node's paces; every level on the GameBoard is written by that same act ([a family's write](#the-primitives)), every count is a reading of the record, its share over the wall W_c ([the count is the record's share](#the-count-is-the-records-share)), and everything else is a number in a file. Every family, at every Node, with the wall w, the read coefficient R_a on
each axis a, the self coefficient S, the level a_now at the interval's
start, a_before one interval earlier, and the remainder r kept at the Node:

  w a_next + r' = SUM_a R_a (arr_(+a) + arr_(-a)) + S a_now - w a_before + r,
  0 <= r' < w,

arr_(±a) the **arrival** through the Port ±a: the neighbour's level; 0 beyond an open face;
the Node's own level on a folded axis. The remainder r is the Node's own
and never travels.

The coefficients at a Node, from its paces ([the paces](#the-paces)) and its
family's pair [num, den]:

  w   = 6 den Gamma^2,
  R_a = 2 num p_a^2,
  S   = 12 den Gamma^2 - 12 (den - num) p_0^2 - 4 num (p_x^2 + p_y^2 + p_z^2).

At the vacuum's pace p_0 = p_a = Gamma the line is the plain second-order
rule of the pair: a_next + a_before = 2 cos omega a_now with the
six-neighbour coupling, the rotation omega_0 with cos omega_0 = num /
den at wave number zero. A held family's field steps at its row's pair at the Node's pace, its own level among the content it reads (**Every row reads the content**, [the paces](#the-paces)), the wall 3 den at the vacuum's pace, at first order.
**The clock once and the Link twice**, the two paces in one line: from the coefficients above, the rotation at a Node of the clock's pace p_0 and the Link's paces p_a is cos omega = 1 - (1 - num / den) (p_0 / Gamma)^2 - (num / (3 den)) SUM_a (p_a / Gamma)^2 (1 - cos k_a), the mass term scaling with the clock's square and the band term with the Link's pace. Two readings follow and no third.

(i) **The clocks shift alike**: at k = 0 every massive band's rest rotation obeys 1 - cos omega_b = (p_0 / Gamma)^2 (1 - cos omega_0), one factor for every family, so two bound bodies at one Node shift their clocks alike (the redshift Phi = c / Gamma to the first order) and, since the owner's word of 2026-10-01, 17:02, every bound line with them (**The same clock and the same ruler for every act**, [the paces](#the-paces)), and a packet's fall in a pace gradient, Delta x |d omega_b / d c| x (c_+ - c_-) / D, does not depend on its family beyond the band's own Delta and d omega_b / d c (item 3 of [what is open](#what-is-open)).

(ii) **The Link is twice**: along a Link every record's speed falls with p_a = (p_0^2 / Gamma) (Gamma - t_a) / Gamma, Gamma - 2 c - t_a to first order, the level entering the Link twice and the clock once, the Node's own content read twice, the Link the clock twice (**The paces compose**, [the paces](#the-paces); the two-end pace of the owner's word of 2026-10-01, 10:45, p_a(i, j) = Gamma - c_i - c_j - t_a, replaced by the word of 15:32, **The clock is the Node's, the tension is the Link's**, [the paces](#the-paces)), so light, which reads the vacuum's row as every family does, is delayed and bent into a mass by twice the clock's share (the bending 4 U_1 / b, [the rows against nature](#the-rows-against-nature) (b)). The line is not conformal: a light record at a fixed wave number scales with (p_a / Gamma)^2 and a bound mode at rest with (p_0 / Gamma)^2, and the two differ already at the first order in c / Gamma (0.625 against 0.411 at c = 3,000 of 12,000 on [8000, 12000], k = 0 against pi); a light record's rotation is conserved along its path, the paces being static, so a light record read against a matter clock at one level reads the clock's shift, (i), and the bending reads (ii).

### The direction

Let sigma be the direction, +1 forward and -1 backward, and let div and
mod be the floor division and its remainder in [0, w), and rho the
remainder carried in. With

  u = sigma (SUM_a R_a arr_a + S x - w y) + rho,
  z = sigma (u div w),  rho' = u mod w,

forward (x, y, rho) = (a_now, a_before, r) gives (z, rho') = (a_next, r');
backward (x, y, rho) = (a_now, a_next, r') gives (z, rho') = (a_before, r).

**Proof**. Forward, sigma = 1, the line is the definition of div and mod.
Backward, sigma = -1: write Y for the right side's first two terms, SUM_a
R_a arr_a + S a_now. Then u = w a_next - Y + r', and z = -floor(u / w) =
ceil((Y - w a_next - r') / w). From the forward line, Y - w a_next - r' = w
a_before - r with 0 <= r < w, whose ceiling divided by w is a_before
exactly; and rho' = u - w floor(u / w) = w a_before - (Y - w a_next - r') =
r. So the backward call returns (a_before, r) bit for bit; the reversibility
of every run needs no second function. Checked bit for bit on 20,000 random
cases against a forward and a backward function written separately.

**The cube's symmetry** (the mathematician's 166, #1572 comment 5955528656, the theorem with its proof act by act, and the advisor's second hand, #1563 comment 5955658812 (C), his mirror r -> (w - r) mod w one case of it, with one addition on the symmetric lay's start; two hands). **Theorem** (the step commutes with the cube's 48). A lay invariant under one of the cube's 48 symmetries, each line carried by its kind (the scalars equal at the image, the vector lines' components permuted and signed with the axes) and each signed component's remainder carried as its complement w - 1 - r, is invariant to the bit under every act of the step, so one fundamental domain of 1 / 48 steps the whole (theorem, GameBoard). In words: let g be one of the 48, a signed permutation of the three axes about the board's centre Node, g e_a = s_a e_a' with e_a the unit step along the axis a, a' the axis it is carried to and s_a its sign, +1 or -1. A state is g-symmetric when at every Node x and its image g x every scalar line is equal (the time lines, the plane's two lines re and im, the internal plane not moved by g, the content holder's level, the held rows' rests and their remainders r), every Link quantity is carried Link to Link (the Link's factor q_ij and the tension t_a of the Link from x through the Port +a equal those of the Link from g x through g e_a), and every vector line (the sign holder's three odd lines, L_a its level on the axis a, and the Wronskian current J_a) is carried as a vector, L_a'(g x) = s_a L_a(x), its remainder r where s_a = +1 and w - 1 - r where s_a = -1, w the wall of that line's division. Where the odd lines and their sources are 0 (a neutral standing world; a real-profile mode rotating uniformly, J_a = 0 exactly) nothing is signed and nonzero, and the plain lay with equal remainders is g-symmetric already.

**Proof**, act by act. (1) Rule3 at a Node: with the numerator u = SUM_a R_a (arr_(+a) + arr_(-a)) + S a_now - w a_before + r, a_next = u div w and r' = u mod w. For a scalar line the image Node has the same six arrivals with the Ports permuted, the same R_a (the Link's factors carried Link to Link), the same S (the paces from the scalar content) and the same r, so the integer u, a_next and r' are equal; for a vector component with s_a = +1 the same. For s_a = -1 every term of the sum is negated and the remainder is w - 1 - r, so u(g x) = -(u - r) + (w - 1 - r) = w - 1 - u, and by the integer identity floor((w - 1 - u) / w) = -floor(u / w) for every integer u (u = q w + s with the quotient q and 0 <= s < w gives w - 1 - u = (-q) w + (w - 1 - s) with 0 <= w - 1 - s < w: the ones' complement commutes with the floor division by a positive wall, no case excepted) the image's level is -a_next exactly and its remainder (w - 1 - u) mod w = w - 1 - r', the complement again. (2) The write, (the numerator + r) div E with the remainder kept: a scalar source's numerator (the form D) is equal at the image, a vector source's (the current J_a, the weight times now_i before_j - before_i now_j, antisymmetric in its two ends and formed with no division) is signed with the axis, and the carried division is the identity of (1) with the complement remainder. (3) The reads: the content and the six Link factors are scalars and Link quantities with no division but the Link factor's own, q_ij the same integer from both ends and from a carried tension; the tension's part h_a(i) = now_(i-a) now_(i+a) - now_i^2 is even in a and takes no division. (4) The time turn: the pair (re, im) is turned by the holder's time level at the Node, a scalar, the same numerator at the image; the three shears act on equal pairs, so each floor is the same floor; the shears act in the internal plane, which g leaves fixed. (5) The Link turn: the pair arriving through the Port +a is turned by the numerator L_a(i) + L_a(i + a) and the pair through -a by -(L_a(i - a) + L_a(i)); under s_a = -1 the image of the Port +a is the Port -a' and the odd line is negated, so the Port -a' turns by -(-L_a(i + a) - L_a(i)) = L_a(i) + L_a(i + a), the same integer fed to the same shears on the same arriving pair: the two signs cancel in the numerator before any floor, so the turn is exact under every g with no condition. (6) A Node fixed by g, on a mirror plane or an axis: a component with s_a = -1 satisfies L = -L, so its level is 0; its six arrivals pair off with opposite signs under equal R_a, so u = r, its level stays 0 and its remainder is a constant the step never reads; the write's numerator there is 0 by the current's antisymmetry; no complement condition applies at a fixed Node. The step is then one integer function of the state commuting with g, so the orbit of a g-symmetric lay is g-symmetric at every interval, forward and back (the inverse step is the same acts in the reverse order, above). Stepping one fundamental domain, with the arrivals from outside the domain read as the domain's levels signed (Rule3 reads levels only, never a neighbour's remainder), reproduces the whole board bit for bit, the whole's state at an image Node the domain's with the level signed and the remainder complemented where signed.

**The symmetric lay**: the held lines' remainders start at wall div 2 (**The start**, [the generator](#the-generator)), so a signed line's image starts at the complement wall - 1 - wall div 2, one below wall div 2 for an even wall; and the board's centre is a Node, an odd shape, as the 25-cube is. A signed component's remainder laid as 0 at every Node is not g-symmetric, the complement of 0 being w - 1: from such a lay an odd line's image level is -a_next - 1 at the first interval wherever w does not divide u, since floor(-u / w) = -ceil(u / w) (on a chain of 41 Nodes at [2, 3], Gamma 1,000, random levels within 1,000, the zero-remainder mirror broke at 38 of 41 Nodes at the first interval, the complement mirror held to the bit, levels and remainders, over 200 intervals, and the two's-complement mirror r -> (w - r) mod w held from random remainders and fails exactly where r = 0 or w divides u). **What breaks it**, three things by name: a signed component's remainders laid at 0 (above); a reflection that also conjugates the internal plane (im -> -im, the sense reversed), which needs the angle reversed in the shears, and the second shear's floor, (2 n d x_1) div (d^2 + n^2) with n / d the tangent half-angle and x_1 the level it reads, is not odd in its numerator, so the 48 act on the Nodes with the plane fixed, a mirror pair of records of opposite sense does not step exactly, and a lay carries the same sense on both sides of every mirror (the three shears' order is untouched because the plane is untouched); and an asymmetric declaration, faces, Link factors, a detector's region or a holder's rest laid without the symmetry, which breaks it at once by the declaration and not by rounding. Nothing of the time-Link turn is needed: the proof uses the turn as the law holds it. Status: theorem, two hands; fence: GameBoard.

### The four acts

Rule3's line is one act; declared coefficients make it four:

(a) **The read**, the line above over the GameBoard (the six arrivals); (b) **The one-Node step**, the line with the neighbours' reads declared 0: a_next +
a_before = (a / b) a_now, the rotation by the angle whose doubled cosine is
a / b (Chebyshev's recurrence); with a / b = 1 and the coefficient on
a_before declared 0 it keeps a level; with a / b = 2 from (0, 1) it counts,
a_t = t; (c) **The division**, the line with R = S = 0: w a_next + r' = the
numerator + r, Euclid's division with the remainder kept; (d) **The load**, a
declared integer in the numerator, how a count enters a level.

**A composition** of Rule3's acts with declared coefficients is a finite
sequence of these acts, each with its coefficients (a pair, a weight, a
wall, a load) declared in the files, applied to declared levels.

**Theorem** (what the acts can form). Every composition of the four acts is
a piecewise-linear function of the levels with integer slopes: a sum of
linear forms and of floors of linear forms, composed. No such function
is quadratic in the levels.

**Proof**. Each act is a linear form of the levels or the floor of one; a
floor of a linear form is piecewise linear with integer slopes; sums and
compositions of piecewise-linear functions with integer slopes are of
the same kind. The second difference of such a function in any one
level is 0 almost everywhere, while the second difference of a product
now_i before_j in the pair (now_i, before_j) is 1. So nothing bilinear
comes from the acts alone.

What the theorem separates: every product of two levels in the engine
is a **booking**, a reading of a bilinear form with declared
coefficients and no write ([the booking](#the-booking)); the one thing written from a
product is a held row's source (the write of the form, the Wronskian's quanta and the tension, [the primitives](#the-primitives)); the count is a product read and never written ([the count is the record's share](#the-count-is-the-records-share)), and its change is Rule3's own conserved current.

**The three tests of every rule**. A line enters the law only if it is
generic (one primitive with declared integers, no family's name and no
kind), vector (one of the acts on the state, no root and no float) and
local (its own record and the six neighbours, nothing kept at a Node
beyond the law's numbers). A hypothesis that needs more is stated under
its own name, outside the law.

### The paces

The **pace** of a Node for a family is what its reads make of the Node
clock:

  p_0 = Gamma (1 - 1 / Gamma)^c to the unit, the clock, Gamma e^(-c / Gamma) to O(1 / Gamma), its square Gamma^2 - 2 Gamma c + 2 c^2 to the second order (**The paces compose** below),  c = SUM over the reads of (weight x the read family's time level at the Node), the reading row's own level among them where it holds the content,
  p_a(i, j) x p_a(i, j) = p_i^2 q_ij^2 / Gamma^2,  p_i = p_0(i)^2 / Gamma,  q_ij = Gamma - t_a(i, j),  a = x, y, z, the Link from the Node i to its neighbour j through the Port a, p_i the Node's pace, the clock twice (Gamma - 2 c_i to first order, **The paces compose**), its own content c_i read twice, and q_ij the Link's factor from the Link's tension t_a(i, j), one number per Link from the read families' axis parts at its two ends, read the same from both ends (**The interval's dependency radius is one Link**, [the interval](#the-interval); **The tension**, [the primitives](#the-primitives)); the product and not the sum, Gamma - 2 c_i - t_a(i, j) to first order and Gamma - 2 c in a uniform level with no tension (**Every row reads the content** and **The clock is the Node's, the tension is the Link's** below),

one division per read per Link, rounded at the read: the pace is a coefficient of the interval and no level, so no remainder is kept for it (nothing at a Node but the law's numbers). A positive weight is a hollow (the read family's level
slows the clock, an attraction); a negative weight is a hill. The reads are the family's dimension's and its declaration's (**Every family has a dimension**, [a family's declaration](#a-familys-declaration); the read of the owner's decision of 2026-10-02, 07:05, **The final unification**): every family reads the holders its declaration names at the weights it names and sources each at the weight it reads with; the holders of gravity and of the binding row every family reads at the weight 1, the held rows among the readers, a holder of the content its own level among it (**Every row reads the content** below), the nuclear holders the nucleon families alone (**The nuclear holder**, [the hypotheses under their own names](#the-hypotheses-under-their-own-names)), a family of dimension 2 (a plane) reads every holder of the sign plainly (light, the holder's own real record of dimension 1, reads none), and no weight and no dimension is read from a Node's own state, the files declare them (the engine as it stands reads every holder of the content at the weight 1, until the engine round lands). A family with no reads steps at p_0 = p_a = Gamma, the plain rule. The clock's slowing
is this pace: a record at a Node of pace p rotates and moves as a record

nothing.

### The generator

The generator builds every world from zero; it declares nothing and
holds no float.

(a) **The input and the region**. The input is a world file in the law's
form: the GameBoard, the Node clock, the universe file it names and one
body by its Nodes with their counts; nothing on the command line. The
iteration runs on the body's Nodes and their surroundings, out to where
the mode's tail falls below one unit; the count stays on the body's Nodes.

(b) **The iteration**. Rule3's read act with the before-coefficient 0, a <-
(SUM_a R_a arr_a + S a) div w on the region, run at the amplitude 2^16 and
scaled to the amplitude unit A by the division act at the end alone (the
level times A over its largest size): the power iteration of the symmetric
form's top mode (the bound mode, above the band, the eigenvalue largest in size), at cos omega_0 / cos omega_b per step; the read act at a small amplitude zeroes the tail's levels of 1 and 2 and stops on a mode half as wide (**Computed**, 600 quanta on a chain: [106, 91, 63, 35, 14, 2, 0] against the mode's [106, 105, 85, 62, 44, 30, 20, 13, 9, 6, 4, 2.5, 1.6]), so the region grows until its outer envelope is 0 and nothing inside it is purged.

(c) **The stop from the integers, the standing read**. The profile is an integer vector bounded by A, so the iteration is a map on a finite set and enters a cycle; the stop is the first repeat, exact, no tolerance and no declared count, the profile there the mode within one unit of A. A record stands when between two whole cycles of its rotation (P_body intervals) the form D_i = now_i^2 - next_i before_i returns to itself at every Node of its region within one quantum, |D_i(t + P_body) - D_i(t)| < T (the form is the count's shadow: a form that drifts by T over a cycle moves a quantum, and a standing record moves none); the region is every Node whose form is at least a hundredth of a quantum, T div 100, the mode's tail falling by e^(-2 kappa) per Link in the form with cosh kappa = (3 den / num) cos omega_b - 2 on a chain and by the support function of [the shape] in a box, and nothing inside the region is purged; a reading of the centre alone is a reading and no stop, and a record whose form drifts by T or more at any Node of its region is a packet and no mode.

**The quantum's action sets the resolution**: one rounding of a level at the amplitude A moves 2 A / T of a quantum of form, so at T = 64 no record of 600 quanta stands at any amplitude (the rounding a third of a quantum in the tail per interval; the reader refuses and the engine spreads the count from the width 4 to 26), while from T = 4,096 the same record stands (599 of 600 quanta carried on 19 Nodes, held 1,000 intervals by the engine, the count's width 2.7 to 3.2 as laid, 0 to 6 quanta beyond the set): the universe's T for worlds of bodies is the owner's, the shipped worlds keep 64 bit for bit.

level is the read act once more, halved (**M** phi = 2 cos omega_b
phi); the two levels are scaled together
so that the weighted share the record lays over its region carries c,
the body's count (**The lay and the wall**), its sources the vacuum's

### The velocity

Rule3 is translation-invariant, so the record's wave number k is conserved
where no pace gradient stands: the record's centre moves at its group
velocity v_g(k) exactly, bound or spreading. The count follows the record as
its share: with the record's norm c T the current across the body's
face is c T v_g per interval, so c v_g quanta cross per interval and the
share's centroid moves at v_g, exact up to the rounding. The well moves
with the count one quantum at a time, 1 / c_i of a Link, so the record is
never kicked by a whole Link; the leak of a hop of the whole well by one
Link, delta = 1 - <phi | X phi>^2 with X the shift by one Link, is 0.031 at
side 12 and 1000 per Node (0.021 at 500, 0.040 at 2000; 0.099 at side 6 and
2000; 0.38 at side 3 and 5000; 0.999 at one Node and 9000), and per Link of
travel delta / c = 3 x 10^-5 at side 12 and 1000: the bound norm, and with
it the velocity, falls by 3 x 10^-5 per Link there. A one-Node body of one
quantum binds nothing and is a free record: its velocity is v_g(k) with no
count to follow it.

The run beside these numbers (the cube of side 12 on [800, 1200] at 1000 per
Node at v = 1 / 3 on a periodic box, 10^4 intervals): the count's centroid
against v t, the slope v within the remainder; the share inside the cube
0.92 at the start, falling by at most 3 x 10^-5 per Link; the clock's period

### The postulates

1. The world is Nodes and Events. Space is the GameBoard; an Event is a change of a
NodeState: a level stepped by Rule3 with its remainder; a click is a detector's report of the currents and, where its draw realises it, the detector's write at one Node; nothing else happens. 2. A Node holds bounded local information: its
NodeState, fixed in size, read from itself and its six neighbours; no read
beyond them, no list that grows with the world, nothing of the past kept.
Every physical update uses its own record and the six causally available
neighbours with fixed work and storage for a fixed set of families
(LOCALITY-1); a self-field estimated or subtracted from anything global is
forbidden, whatever the size of its final answer. 3. Consistency is local
and causal: an Event first changes its own Node and travels Link by Link,
one Link per interval, each Node updating on receipt under the same rule;
the one exception is the production of a click, the instrument's credit of one quantum to one detector by the shares over every declared detector that reads one record, through the root, the one non-local place, not derived; the realised click's write is local, at one Node, and spreads by Rule3; and no quantum changes family at a crossing.
4. The causal speed is one Link per interval, built in; every
other speed is a rational, a count of Links over a count of intervals. 5.
Every physical calculation is on bounded integers; there is no float, no root and no draw in the law, the draw the instrument's with its declared seed; a Node keeps only the law's own numbers: each
part's two levels and Rule3's remainder (a family of quanta's real pair
and its second, the rotation sense; a held family's parts), a held part's
one write remainder, the family's pair and the Node clock from the content
there, and nothing else; its count, its sense, its currents and its tension are readings. 6. A measurement is a detector's click, a
reading of the state: the net current into the declared region through its front boundary Ports over
one interval, reported with the region and the family and never a Node; one quantum is credited to one detector by the shares, the instrument's draw with its declared seed, the instrument's declaration (for a record of two parts the share the joint share, the parts paired through the root and squared, [the click is the meeting](#the-click-is-the-meeting)), the realised click written at the one Node from which the quantum reached the detector, the instrument's act and the one write outside the reversal, and which meeting is realised is not derived. Only a click is compared with nature or pinned as an expectation; displays and the host's readings read state and write nothing.
7. The Inside is the GameBoard, where no one measures, deterministic and bit-reversible between clicks, holding the future with no arrow; the Outside is the detectors and their clicks, realised events, the detectors bodies of the board with two sides and the clicks carrying the arrow, the only thing claimed to represent nature.
